<thought>Only carbon shows a clear isotopic envelope with successive peaks spaced ~1 Da and decreasing intensities following a binomial distribution, which is characteristic of the 12C/13C pattern. No other element (Cl, Br, S, etc.) exhibits its distinctive isotopic spacing or intensity ratios in the observed spectrum, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
